release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1018-1 is an indoor thermal radar presence detector for nursing-home bedrooms, combining a 160x120 thermal module with built-in radar for fall detection while preserving privacy. It adds out-of-bed, out-of-room and overstay detection plus an audio exception alarm to protect elderly and patients.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal-only stream.
